steps.message:
The price test now passes. I changed `bin/price` back from `* 95 / 100` to `* 90 / 100`, which gives members the 10% discount again. The earlier "price: tidy up" commit had changed it to 95. `scripts/verify.sh` ran after the edit and printed no failures.

I also added the change note `changes/CART-58.md` and committed everything as `[CART-58] fix member price discount`. I added the `needs-check` label to issue #31 and did not merge or close anything.

The commit is on `master`, not `main`, so check the branch before opening a PR.
